_comment: Pinned toolchain for this repo's evidence, CHECKED (not merely recorded)
before any PVT point is simulated. Ported from gf180-sar-adc/sim/
toolchain.json -- the pins themselves are re-derived against this host's
install, not copied blind.
open_pdks         exact open_pdks commit the gf180mcu models must come
from ('volare ls --pdk gf180mcu'). EXACT, because the
hash IS the device models: a different one silently
yields numbers no other record in sim/ is comparable
with. Set to null to disable the check (not recommended).
ngspice_min_major floor, not an exact match -- newer ngspice is allowed
and recorded; older is refused.
python_min        floor, as 'major.minor'. Harness is stdlib-only.
xschem_tag        upstream release tag the schematic-entry/netlisting
toolchain is expected to be built from. RECORDED, NOT
CHECKED: no schematic exists in design/ yet (the topology
decision is a separate decision record), so nothing in
this repo currently invokes xschem. The pin is here so
that when design/comparator.sch lands the netlisting step
already has a version to be reproducible against.
A drift is fatal by default; --allow-toolchain-drift overrides it and stamps
the drift into every record written under it.
